mercimek.name: Suphu ya Nthochi
mercimek.description: Suphu ya nthochi yopangidwa kunyumba mu njira ya chikhalidwe, yomalizidwa ndi msuzi wa batala.

tas-kebabi.name: Stiyuu ya Ng'ombe ya ku Turkey
tas-kebabi.description: Ng'ombe, masamba a nthawiyo, ndi msuzi wapadera wa m'nyumba yathu womwe umaphikidwa pang'onopang'ono.

kuzu-tandir.name: Ng'ombe Kokhowa Yopondera Mozungulira
kuzu-tandir.description: Lamb tandoori yapadera ya m'nyumba yathu, imaphikidwa pang'ono ndi moto wotsika.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Mpunga Pilau
pirinc-pilavi.description: Pilau ya mpunga wa Baldo yokazinga ndi batala, yofewa.

firin-sutlac.name: Mapulu a Mpunga Ofiira mu Oveni
firin-sutlac.description: Mapulu a mpunga ofiira mu njira ya chikhalidwe, okonzedwa ndi mkaka wa nyankhula wa tsiku ndi tsiku.

kuru-fasulye.name: Mjira wa Nkhama ndi Mbewa Zoyera
kuru-fasulye.description: Mbewa za İspir, nyama ya ng'ombe yodulidwa, ndi pasta ya nyanya yatsopano yasitolo.

izgara-kofte.name: Nyama Zophika pa Grill
izgara-kofte.description: Nyama za ng'ombe zopangidwa ngati ziwiri zogwira ntchito ndi tsabola wophikidwa ndi nyanya.

ayran.name: Ayran Wosanjidwa
ayran.description: Buttermilk wosanjidwa wodziwika, wokhala ndi mpweya wambiri, wopangidwa ndi yogurt watsiku ndi tsiku.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Suphu yachikhalidwe yasitolo yomwe nyemba zobiriwira, bulgur, ndi mpunga zimakumana ndi minti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana yapakhomo, chinthu chachikhalidwe cha Anatolian chimaphikika pang'onopang'ono ndi nyanya ndi minti yowuma.

yayla-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Yogati ndi Mpunga
yayla-corbasi.description: Suphu yosangalatsa komanso yowuma yopangidwa ndi yogati, mpunga, ndi m'boga woomatidwa.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Mimba ya Ng'ombe
iskembe-corbasi.description: Suphu yoyenera ya mimba ya ng'ombe imatumikidwa ndi zonunkhira zake ndi viniga wa adyo.

dugun-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Chikondwerero cha Moyo Wokhazikika
dugun-corbasi.description: Suphu ya chikondwerero cha mabanja yopangidwa ndi nyama ya nkhumba yomwe yatsala ndikuikidwamo ndi marinade ya limesi.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Nkhuku
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Suphu yopulika yopangidwa ndi ndiyo yopepuka yopikidwa mu msuzi wa mafupa ndi nyama ya nkhuku yomwe yatsala.

domates-corbasi.name: Suphu ya Tomato
domates-corbasi.description: Chakudya chokoma chokonzedwa ndi madomasi okwanira, batala, ndi basil, chokwaniritsidwa ndi tchizi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Soup ya Mbeu
sebze-corbasi.description: Soup yofewa yophika m'nyumba yosangalatsa yopangidwa ndi ndiwo za nyengo, mafuta a maolivi, ndi zipatso zazatsopano.

beyran-corbasi.name: Soup ya Ng'ombe Yopatsa Mpweya Wotentha
beyran-corbasi.description: Soup ya dera yopangidwa pa moto wapamwamba ndi nyama ya ng'ombe, mpunga, adyo, ndi tsabola wotentha.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Soup ya Mutu ndi Mphuno za Ng'ombe
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Soup yolimba ya m'bone yopangidwa ndi mipando ya ng'ombe ndi nyama ya mutu yoponderedwa maola ambiri.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Soup ya Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Mzira wamakolo wokonzedwa ndi msuzi wa nkhuku wokhala ndi madomasi, vermicelli, ndi parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Masikewa a Nkhuku
tavuk-sis.description: Zidutswa za nkhuku zomwe zapangidwa ndi masamba apadera, kuperekedwa ndi tsabola wophika ndi madomasi.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk ya Wogulitsa Ng'ombe Yogawidwa pa Moto
kasap-sucuk.description: Sausage ya nkhumba yopatsa moto yomwe idaphikidwa pa charaki, ndi ndiwo zophika ndi anyezi ndi sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill Zosiyanasiyana
karisik-izgara.description: Chakudya chachikhalidwe ndi chosiyanasiyana chopangidwa ndi mabola a nyama, masikewa a nkhuku, ma lamb chop, ndi sausage.

nohut-yemegi.name: Stew ya Chickpea ndi Nkhumba
nohut-yemegi.description: Chakudya cham'manja cha nyemba za chickpeas ndi nyama ya ng'ombe yodulidwa kupsinjika m'madzi mkuwa pang'onopang'ono.

patlican-musakka.name: Eggplant Moussaka
patlican-musakka.description: Melanzane yozazidwa, nyama ya ng'ombe yowuma, ndi moussaka wophikidwa mu uvuni ndi msuzi wa mandimu, ngati m'malo odyera.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Green Beans in Olive Oil
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Zoweta ndi mafuta a maolivi pamodzi ndi mbewa zamasamba, madomasi, ndi anyezi, zidakonzedwa kuzizira.

tavuk-sote.name: Sautéed Chicken
tavuk-sote.description: Magawo a nkhuku amaphikidwa ndi moto wochuluka pamwe ndi tsabola zonunkhira, nyama ya champignon, ndi madomasi.

izmir-kofte.name: İzmir-Style Meatballs
izmir-kofte.description: Chakudya chamakhalidwe cha nyama ya ng'ombe yomwe imagwidwa, mbatata, ndi tsabola zokazinga mu msuzi wa tomato.

etli-bezelye.name: Nkhungu ndi Ng'ombe
etli-bezelye.description: Chakudya cha tsiku ndi tsiku chimaphikidwa m'phika ndi nyama ya ng'ombe yokokedwa, nkhungu, karoti, ndi mbatata.

patlican-oturtma.name: Eggplant Yophikidwa ndi Mince
patlican-oturtma.description: Umu umaphikidwa mu uvuni ndi eggplant, nyama yophwanyidwa yodzaza ndi tsabola, ndi msuzi wa gariki tomato.

salgam-suyu.name: Juisi wa Turnip Wophikidwa
salgam-suyu.description: Juisi wamba wa turnip wokometsera womwe ndi wophikidwa ndi karoti wofiira ndi yisiti ya bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Madzi a Mineral
maden-suyu.description: Madzi amdima a mineral okha a chitetezo amatumizidwa ozizira.

su.name: Madzi a M'Nyanja
su.description: Madzi a m'nyanja apangidwa achisewu mu galasi.

kola.name: Kola
kola.description: Chakumwa chakale chokoma cha fizzi ochiritsidwa ndi ice.

gazoz.name: Soda ya Lemon ya ku Turkey
gazoz.description: Soda wamba wokoma, wokoma komanso wokonzedwa achisewu.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kofi ya ku Turkey
turk-kahvesi.description: Kofi wamba wa ku Turkey wokhala ndi mpweya, wapangidwa pa moto waukulu mu chitsulo cha mkuwa.

demleme-cay.name: Ti yokazinga ya ku Turkey
demleme-cay.description: Ti ya Rize yatsopano yokazinga motentha mu galasi lowala lalitali.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lemonade Yapakhomo
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemonade yokoma yopangidwa tsiku lililonse ndi lemoni yatsopano, miyintsi, ndi shuga pang'ono.

hosaf.name: Nyemba Zadzina Zakudya za Phunziro
hosaf.description: Compote yapakhomo yopangidwa tsiku lililonse ndi ma raisins, apricots, kapena ma plums malinga ndi nthawi ya chaka.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Mkaka umakokedwa pa skewer pamwamba pa pide, ukatumikiridwa ndi msuzi wa tomato, batala wotentha, ndi yogurt.

kazandibi.name: Pudingi ya Mkaka Yogawanika
kazandibi.description: Chikondamoyo cha mkaka wamtundu wa chikhalidwe, chokwiyika bwino, chokhala ndi mkate wofewa.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Pudingi wa Mkaka wa Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Chiberekero chabwino komanso chofewa cha mkaka chophika ndi njira zachikhalidwe, choperekedwa ndi sinamoni.

keskul.name: Chiberekero cha Mkaka wa Almond
keskul.description: Chiberekero cha mkaka cha kalembedwe ka Ottoman chokwaniritsidwa ndi kukoma kwa almond ndi kokonati.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva ya Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva ya semolina, yophikidwa ndi batala komanso ma pine nuts, imaperekedwa yotentha komanso yowuma.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Chiberekero cha Pumpkin ndi Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Pumpkin, imaphikidwa pang'onopang'ono mumadzi ake, imaperekedwa ndi tahini ndi walnuts.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Chiberekero cha Quince
ayva-tatlisi.description: Quince imaphikidwa ndi clove ndi sinamoni, imaperekedwa ndi kirimu woyeretsedwa ndi walnuts.

revani.name: Mkate wa Semolina ndi Syrupu
revani.description: Chikondwerero cha macksonzi chakumalo opikira chakomwe mkate wosalala wa semolina umakumana ndi syrupu yokoma yodzaza ndi kununkhira kwa lemoni.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudding wa Mkate ndi Kirimu Wa Clotted
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudding wa mkate wokonzedwa ndi syrupu yokoma umaperekedwa ndi kirimu wa clotted wa nyani.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava ya Ma walnut
cevizli-baklava.description: Zinga zosanjikizidwa komanso zotetezeka, baklava yozizira yopangidwa ndi ma walnut ambiri ndi batala wochita bwino.
